user.title: Add Uplift Desk
user.description:
Choose how you want to add your desk.

If your desk is nearby and discoverable via Bluetooth, select it below. Otherwise, use manual entry to provide the address and name.

user_manual.title: Manual Desk Entry
user_manual.description: Enter the Bluetooth address and a name for your desk.

user_confirm.title: Confirm Desk Details
user_confirm.description:
Please confirm the details for your desk:

**Name:** `{name}`
**Address:** `{address}`

error.invalid_address: Invalid Bluetooth address. Please enter a valid address (e.g., `AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF`).
error.connection_failed: Failed to connect to the desk. Please ensure the desk is powered on and within range.
error.unknown_error: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
error.no_device_found: The selected device is no longer available. Please try again or use manual entry.

abort.connection_failed: Failed to connect to the desk. Please ensure the desk is powered on and within range.
abort.invalid_address: The discovered device is not a supported desk.
